reviews.title: Terrible Moderation
reviews.text:
The app itself is fine, and can be kind of entertaining at times. However, where Yik Yak completely fails is its moderation. In the event your post is taken down, there is never a reason given as to why; you're only told that it violated a rule, but not which rule, or how it violated said rule. Also, if your account is muted, you are not given the option to appeal whatsoever. I have had multiple instances of my account being muted due to entirely unclear reasoning, and there is absolutely nothing that can be done other than wait it out.
Mind you, most of the really heinous posts and comments are left up for hours; and to top off how much of a joke the moderation is, there are sexually explicit ads littered throughout the entire app that cannot be hidden unless you fork over 5 dollars a month for their pro subscription. 
It's infuriating how absolutely horrible the app's moderation is. Until it's fixed, it's getting 1 star from me.

reviews.title: Silencing Important Information
reviews.text:
Yik Yak used to be a place where you could post your true opinions and thoughts in your community. If something was truly disliked, the community will downvote the post and comment why the OP is wrong. It encouraged the community to see other sides of a situation and allowed for discussion. 

But now, you can get banned by saying your own personal beliefs and opinions. I once posted a Bible verse on Yik Yak at my Christian school and was banned for 48 hours. I didn’t even quote the Bible verse, just put the book, chapter and verse number (for example, “Genesis 1:1”). It is obvious that posting a Bible verse written like the example above IS NOT grounds for being banned. 

Mostly posts are banned because one or two people have a differing opinion than OP. Even if a post is heavily upvoted by the community (therefore, generally agreed upon), just one person can get the OP banned, rather than having a discussion in the comments. 

AND once you’re banned from Yik Yak for however many hours (24, 48, 72, etc.) there is no option to contact someone at Yik Yak to potentially appeal the ban. 

If you’re going to heavily ban and silence certain opinions, the consumer has a right to contact some sort of support line to further inquire about why they were banned and potentially make a case as to why their post does not constitute being banned.

reviews.title: Terrible app, horrible crowd, invasive ads
reviews.text:
Beyond the horrible social atmosphere, lackluster moderation and poor design, the app is riddled with intrusive pop-up ads with no minimum delay between them.

I'm writing this because I just got 10 of these ads in the span of 5 seconds. I was trying to type 2 sentences and couldn't because every half second it would show another one that'd I'd have to swipe away from. Many of these ads are deeply inappropriate and creepy btw. They also cause your autocorrect to activate since you stop typing but you'll be halfway through a word and it gets it wrong; You have to delete the entire word and try again and - oop - another ad!

The automated moderation system is easily misused by bad actors. Spam reporting gets innocent users temp banned all the time while absolutely horrible, clearly TOS breaking stuff stays up indefinitely.

I've been a pretty active user for several years now but this has gone beyond downhill. The app is a garbage dump now. I wanted this to be a fallback after leaving several other platforms but no longer. Not worth the harassment, bullying, bigotry and terrible scrolling experience.
